plain_summary_en: This paper studies The Effects of Target Characteristics on Public Support for Hate Speech Laws. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Public support, Political science, Social psychology, Psychology. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
